project_info.color_palette: Near Black, Bright Yellow, White, Soft Cream, Red Ribbon Accent

main_subject.detail: A split layout with a tall black left panel containing REF_BRAND_LOGO and a torn paper receipt reading {{BUY_GET_COPY}} and {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, plus three cream product shelf rows on the right populated by REF_CATEGORY_ROW_1, REF_CATEGORY_ROW_2, and REF_CATEGORY_ROW_3.
main_subject.style: Graphic ecommerce catalogue, bold coupon typography, realistic packshot shelves, simple giveaway iconography

composition_elements.type: Offer receipt / product rows / gift prop
items: Left: Fixed black vertical brand panel with REF_BRAND_LOGO.
Left Center: Torn white receipt with yellow header, oversized {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, and a red-ribbon yellow gift box at the bottom.
Right: Three equal cream shelf zones; each zone holds one REF_CATEGORY_ROW product group.
Background: Pale-yellow surround with clear white gutters between category rows.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even shelf illumination, gentle packshot shadows, strong receipt contrast

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity retail catalogue poster with graphic coupon panel

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup buy-two offer catalog. Preserve the split composition: black left brand strip, a torn white offer receipt with {{BUY_GET_COPY}} and {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, yellow gift box with {{GIFT_LABEL}}, and exactly three cream shelf rows on the right. Populate each row with REF_CATEGORY_ROW_1, REF_CATEGORY_ROW_2, and REF_CATEGORY_ROW_3. Keep products upright, label-facing, and evenly spaced.
prompt.negative_prompt: more or fewer than three product rows, unreadable discount, wrong logo, distorted packaging, products not facing forward, unsupported offer terms, watermark, crowded shelves

assets.name: Receipt-and-three-shelf catalog layout
assets.usage: Preserve left receipt panel and exactly three right shelf rows.

assets.name: Ultimate Sup logo
assets.usage: Keep in the black top-left brand panel.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach REF_LAYOUT, logo, and all selected packshots. Use the layout for an offer overview; do not imply that unlisted products are eligible.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Use exact approved offer mechanics and percentage/value.
Use only when a real gift is included.
Replace each row with eligible campaign SKUs only.
